about_the_game:
A lone rhino. A vast savanna. Packages that must be delivered.

Lost under the crimson African sun, our determined rhino postal worker has a job to do! But the savanna is full of obstacles, tight spaces, and tricky terrain that make each delivery a puzzle to solve.

Help our rhino navigate through handcrafted puzzle challenges where every step matters and every move could be the difference between success and starting over. The red sun beats down mercilessly, but this rhino won't give up on the people counting on their deliveries!

Features

  • 100+ carefully designed puzzle challenges that will challenge both newcomers and puzzle veterans

  • Charming pixel art brings the African savanna to life under that iconic red sun

  • Pure logic-based gameplay - no timers, no pressure, just you, the rhino, and the puzzles

  • Perfect bite-sized experience designed for approximately 2 hours of engaging gameplay

  • Classic puzzle mechanics with a heartwarming delivery theme

  • Single-player puzzle solving at your own pace

Whether you're a puzzle game veteran or new to logic challenges, this rhino needs your help! Each level teaches new ways to think about space, movement, and logistics. The packages won't deliver themselves, and the people of the savanna are counting on you.

Will you help our rhino hero complete the most important delivery route of their life?

Development Status Note

This game is currently in development. Add it to your wishlist to stay updated on our progress and be notified when it launches!
